crossRefs.note: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel…
God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

parallels.note: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

people.name: Issachar

people.name: Puah
people.line: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob

people.name: Tola
people.line: Son of Issachar, ancestor of the Tolaites

translations.web: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Issachar by their clans: The Tolaite clan from Tola, the Punite clan from Puvah,
